title: Raoul
html_source:
Raoul is a character in the spicy novel “Sweets of Sin” that Bloom bought for Molly in Chapter 10.

“He read the other title: SWEETS OF SIN. More in her line. Let us see. He read where his finger opened.
–ALL THE DOLLARBILLS HER HUSBAND GAVE HER WERE SPENT IN THE STORES ON WONDROUS GOWNS AND COSTLIEST FRILLIES. FOR HIM! FOR RAOUL!”
